lines.beaver_en: The movie's over. How was it, Minji?
lines.en: I really enjoyed it. It warmed my heart.

lines.beaver_en: Me too. There were some fun scenes, right?
lines.learner: 네, 강아지가 너무 귀여웠어요. 많이 웃었어요.
lines.en: Yes, the puppy was so cute. I laughed a lot.
lines.roman: ne, gangajiga neomu gwiyeowosseoyo. mani useosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. There was a lot of laughing in the theater.
lines.en: The kid adored the puppy and was so happy.

lines.beaver_en: But the puppy went missing in the middle.
lines.en: It vanished suddenly, so I was surprised. It was a bit scary.

lines.beaver_en: That scene was a bit scary for me too.
lines.en: The kid was so sad that I cried too.

lines.beaver_en: Do you remember the scene where the kid got angry?
lines.learner: 네, 아빠한테 짜증을 내고 화를 냈어요.
lines.en: Yes, she got irritated and angry at her dad.
lines.roman: ne, appahante jjajeungeul naego hwareul naesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The dad didn't really understand her feelings.
lines.learner: 그래서 아이의 슬픔이 더 크게 느껴졌어요.
lines.en: So her sorrow felt even bigger.
lines.roman: geuraeseo aiui seulpeumi deo keuge neukkyeojyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I was glad the puppy came back at the end.
lines.en: The kid was so happy. She cried, then laughed.
It was happy and sad. It wasn't boring at all.

lines.beaver_en: It's a shame the movie is over.
lines.en: Me too. Let's watch one together again!
